notes.summary: Proved relative to the complete caller grants: every nontrivially valued retained-field smooth genus-zero curve with actual ample rational L has a descended continuous norming single-atom reference; includes nonsplit conics. No positive-genus realization is proved.
notes.detailedSummary: For K complete, characteristic and residue characteristic zero, real-valued and nontrivially valued, X smooth geometrically integral projective of genus zero, and actual ample rational L of degree a>0, prove finite algebraic splitting X_E=P1_E and actual L_C=O(a). A finite Galois orbit of a Gauss point has a unique type-II finite-tree center. An explicit FS atom metric on the actual upstairs bundle has curvature a delta_y. Q every-solution uniqueness makes that metric invariant after normalization; D descends it and O gives mass a delta_xi. A coefficient Gauss norm computation gives sup u=u(xi) for every FS scalar and every actual allpoint endpoint, verifying the extra N hypothesis rather than assuming it for arbitrary X.
notes.text:
This is a mathematical proof relative to the six supplied complete caller bodies; it remains an unverified draft. The labels O217/D214/N220/T171/Q222/C218 are mathematical caller labels, not registered supporting-note IDs, and no old or unproved general-curve note is used. The exact positive setting is K complete characteristic-zero with residue characteristic zero and a nontrivial real-valued non-Archimedean absolute value, X/K smooth geometrically integral projective with H1(X,O)=0, and actual ample rational L, a=deg L>0. All potentials are actual allpoint fixed-bundle decreasing-FS-net endpoints.

First establish the upstairs geometry instead of assuming Q applies. A finite affine cover and its affine intersections give a Cech complex, and flat field tensor commutes with cohomology. Choose a point P over a finite E0/K. Geometric integrality and properness give H0(X_E0,O)=E0, while H1=0 remains true. On the smooth curve, 0->O->O(P)->O(P)|P->0 supplies two independent sections without common zero, giving f:X_E0->P1 with exactly one simple pole P. The exact sequences for (n-1)P and nP inductively give H1(O(nP))=0 and dim H0(O(nP))=n+1. The functions 1,f,...,f^n form a basis by their distinct pole orders. For any rational q, at each of its finitely many poles R other than P, a polynomial vanishing at the algebraic residue f(R) has positive vanishing order. A product h(f) of high enough powers cancels all those poles. Thus h(f)q lies in H0(O(nP)) for some n and is a polynomial in f. Hence E0(X)=E0(f). The generic inverse extends at every DVR of P1 by properness of X, extends to neighborhoods by finite presentation, and glues by separatedness; both compositions are identity generically and everywhere. This proves an actual isomorphism. Enlarge to finite Galois E/K. Pic(P1_E)=Z by divisor degree: an irreducible polynomial of degree d gives its closed point equivalent to d infinity. Clearing denominators identifies the actual L_E with O(a); degree stays a under geometric field extension, not a times [E:K].

Put C=completed algebraic closure, Y=X_C^an and G=Gal(bar K/K), as in the complete D and Q grants. The chosen splitting is defined over E. Its Gauss point y0 is fixed by Gal(bar K/E), since coefficient automorphisms preserve the Gauss coefficient maximum. Its G orbit S is finite. The semilinear action preserves the actual disk tree and its path length: the coordinate action is a valued coefficient automorphism and a PGL2 matrix (an automorphism pulls back O(1) and acts on its two-dimensional section space). Translations preserve disks, scalings shift log radii by a common constant, and inversion sends a disk (b,r) avoiding zero to (1/b,r/|b|^2), while interchanging the zero/infinity chains on the remaining arcs. These formulas preserve lengths and type II. No path-metric boundedness is inferred merely from analytic compactness.

The hull H of finite S is a finite metric tree with type-II leaves and meet vertices; their radii lie in |C*|. Choose diameter leaves A,B with distance D and midpoint y. If x attaches to [A,B] at coordinate t with height h, diameter maximality gives h<=min(t,D-t), so d(y,x)<=D/2. For any possible center z, its distances to A and B are t+h and D-t+h, so maximum D/2 forces t=D/2 and h=0. Thus y is the unique circumcenter and is G-fixed. The logarithmic value group is divisible, and distances of branch vertices belong to it. A midpoint is consequently type II. The singleton case is immediate.

Write y=zeta(b,|c|). The actual independent sections c T0 and T1-b T0 give a degree-one FS metric with genuine measure delta_y by the complete Q atom construction. Degree-ma monomials in those sections, divided by m, give an actual continuous FS metric phi_y on the identified actual L_C with genuine measure a delta_y. Both phi_y and each semilinear conjugate are continuous finite-energy metrics on this same bundle, and their genuine measures coincide because gy=y. Q every-solution allpoint uniqueness therefore identifies them modulo a real constant. Normalize sup(phi_y-psi0_C)=0 relative to any pulled-back continuous reference; its invariance forces all these constants to be zero. Only at this point use D to descend the invariant actual metric to a continuous psh reference psi on L. O pushforward gives MA_psi(0)=a delta_xi for xi=pi(y), with no field-degree factor.

Atomic curvature alone would not prove norming. In the coordinate sending y to Gauss, every section of O(d) has norm |sum b_j w^j|/max(1,|w|)^d bounded by max |b_j| in both projective charts, with equality at Gauss. Thus every weighted FS scalar attains its supremum at y. Pullback of every downstairs FS system is such a system, and D surjectivity gives sup_T v=v(xi). If v_i decreases allpoint to actual u, its suprema c_i=v_i(xi) decrease. An infinite-negative limit would make u identically infinite-negative, which is excluded. Otherwise u(xi)=inf c_i=sup u is finite, at all points including poles. This proves the full extra reference hypothesis of N for nonsplit genus-zero curves.

The complete argument is in P16.4-argument.md and standalone P16.4-paper.tex. Exact input bodies and clarifications are extracted by python3 extract_grants.py from untouched input.json. Rebuild with python3 build_deliverable.py. The norming proof uses the complete Q/D/O grants, not an ungranted graph-model theorem. It does not prove an actual norming atomic reference for a positive-genus curve or higher-dimensional variety.

notes.summary: Complete new genus-zero equation sector, including nonsplit conics, over every retained complete field: correct raw mass, intrinsic E1 target iff finite dual iff genuine output, actual existence and every-solution allpoint uniqueness. Full P16.4 remains open.
notes.detailedSummary: Using n1 to verify actual splitting, bundle and reference antecedents, apply N downstairs for intrinsic target equivalence, D for mass-preserving invariant lift/dual equality, Q for actual upstairs equation and allpoint uniqueness, and only then D for singular solution descent and O pushforward. T handles trivial valuations. C gives genuine locality/comparison. Affine O differentiation yields attainment. The normalized curve scaling is exactly B(tu)=t^2 B(u), giving A_mu(u)<=U_mu max(1,sqrt B(u)), J<=U+U^2/4 and J=-E for the normalized solution. These are sector theorems relative to supplied grants, not a full arbitrary-dimensional solution.
notes.text:
Retain exactly X/K smooth geometrically integral projective of genus zero, actual ample rational L, a=deg L>0, K complete characteristic-zero real-valued non-Archimedean with residue characteristic zero, including trivial, nontrivial, discrete, nondiscrete and non-algebraically-closed fields. Let psi be any actual continuous psh reference. Continuous curve energy is E(u)=1/2 int u[MA(u)+MA(0)], extended to singular actual psh endpoints by the infimum of continuous psh majorant energies. E1 means this extended energy is greater than negative infinity. The genuine O operator, not a target-assigned inverse, acts on these actual potentials with raw mass a, all-E1 test integrability and all-test weighted arbitrary decreasing-net continuity. C provides strict Borel mixed locality, open locality and comparison in this retained field domain.

The exact target condition is mu positive Radon, mu(T)=a, and J_psi(mu)=sup over continuous actual psh v of [E(v)-int v dmu]<infinity. Constants cancel only at this mass. The theorem proves that it is equivalent to every actual E1 scalar being absolutely mu-integrable, and equivalent to mu=MA(u) for actual u in E1. Every solution, including one not constructed in this proof, is unique modulo one finite constant at every analytic point. No target support or symmetry restriction is imposed.

For nontrivial valuations, n1 gives an actual descended reference with MA(0)=a delta_xi and sup u=u(xi). The complete N theorem now applies on the original carrier and proves the intrinsic converse; it is not inferred merely by testing invariant upstairs singular functions. If normalized u(xi)=0, put B=-E, A_mu=int(-u)dmu, and U_mu=sup{A_mu(u):u actual E1 normalized, B<=1}. N gives all-test integrability iff U finite iff J finite. There is an exact curve improvement: O affine curvature yields MA(tu)=(1-t)a delta_xi+t MA(u). The genuine curve energy and the zero reference integral give E(tu)=t^2 E(u), for 0<t<=1; at t=0 the reference is used without multiplying a pole by zero. All integrals are finite by O. Choosing t=1 or B(u)^(-1/2) yields A_mu(u)<=U_mu max(1,sqrt B(u)). Hence the normalized objective is <=-B+U+U sqrt B and J<=U+U^2/4. Coercivity alone is not called attainment.

Given finite J and mass a, D supplies the unique invariant Radon lift sigma on actual Y=X_C^an, with mass a and J_C(sigma)=J_K(mu). By n1, X_C is actually P1_C and L_C actually O(a); section pullback identifies the genuine FS systems and actual allpoint endpoints, and continuous curvature naturality plus O's decreasing limit identifies operators/energy. Q applies to this actual split geometry, arbitrary-support mass-a finite-dual target and actual reference. It supplies an actual upstairs E1 solution w and uniqueness for every solution at every point. Normalize sup_Y w=0 relative to the invariant pulled-back reference. Semilinear action preserves FS endpoints and, by continuous naturality and O's limits, the genuine measure. Thus g*w solves the same invariant target, and Q uniqueness plus normalization gives g*w=w.

Only after these upstairs antecedents are established does D descend w to an actual downstairs psh u. D extended energy equality is first applied without assuming the endpoint finite: E_K(u)=E_C(w)>-infinity. Now O's finite-energy field law is applicable and gives MA_K(u)=pi_* sigma=mu. No singular potential is averaged. No abstract Hilbert element is named as an actual potential, and no target is used to define MA.

For any two original solutions u,v, O makes their pullbacks finite energy. Their upstairs measures are invariant and both push to mu. D invariant-lift uniqueness makes both equal sigma. Q every-solution uniqueness gives pi*u=pi*v+c at all points; D surjectivity gives u=v+c at every original analytic point. No difference of negative infinities is evaluated. Every output integrates every E1 test by O, so the already verified N criterion proves finite J in the converse direction. For trivial valuations T supplies the actual ample equation and intrinsic target criterion in precisely its granted domain. Its operator agrees with O on continuous data and along the same defining decreasing nets.

Actual attainment follows for every solution. For any E1 competitor v, O concavity and the genuine affine-segment derivative give E(v)-E(u)<=int(v-u)MA(u), with integrable finite-value representatives. Thus u maximizes the objective. Continuous majorants decreasing to u converge in energy and their integrals against the fixed output mu by O weighted continuity, so this maximum is the original continuous-test supremum. In the norming reference with u(xi)=0, E(u)=1/2 int u dmu, giving J(mu)=-E(u) and int u dmu=2E(u). Reference covariance is E_psi'(u-b)=E_psi(u)-E_psi(b) and J_psi'(mu)=J_psi(mu)-E_psi(b)+int b dmu; b is bounded continuous, so finiteness and the absolute equation are independent of reference.

The paper replaces normalized compactness and envelope/orthogonality/both-sign obstacle differentiation as existence inputs by the complete Q actual tree construction and verified geometric/descent antecedents. It does not claim those general inputs have thereby been proved for arbitrary X. C comparison is retained, but uniqueness is actually proved via every-solution Q uniqueness and invariant lifts. The full arbitrary-dimensional original remains unresolved. Artifacts: P16.4-paper.tex, P16.4-paper.pdf and P16.4-argument.md; rerun python3 build_deliverable.py. This is an unverified mathematical proof relative to complete caller O/D/N/T/Q/C, with n1 as its only local result dependency.

notes.summary: Explicit nonsplit nondiscrete conic example and reproducible lightweight evidence: raw mass 2 target with E=-1, target integral -2 and J=1; exact finite checks pass and standalone paper compiles. Execution is not proof certification.
notes.detailedSummary: K=R((t^Q)) is complete with nondiscrete real-valued valuation and residue R; the ordered-field conic X0^2+X1^2+X2^2=0 has no K-point, while its actual O_X(1) has degree 2 and splits over K(i) as O(2). The two radius |t| and |t|^-1 disk points form an orbit and yield a nonreference target 2 delta_eta. Actual atom metrics descend and the curve energy gives E=-1 and J=1. The retained Python program checks the parametrization, 21 half-unit tree-center positions, all 15 denominator-4 targets on a specified three-leaf tree, two-atom mass bookkeeping and an exact two-slope subdivision identity. Existing pandoc/pdfLaTeX produce the paper in two successful passes. These finite observations do not authenticate the analytic theorem.
notes.text:
The mathematical example uses n2 and its supporting actual-reference result. K=R((t^Q)) consists of real-coefficient Hahn series of well-ordered rational exponent support, with |f|=exp(-min supp f). Completeness follows by taking successive differences of a Cauchy subsequence with valuations greater than the integer index; below any fixed bound only finitely many such supports occur, their union is well ordered, and the sum defines the limit. Its residue is R and its value group exp(Q) is nondiscrete; both characteristics are zero. Leading-coefficient positivity orders K. Therefore the smooth geometrically integral conic X0^2+X1^2+X2^2=0 has no K-point: a nonzero sum of squares is positive. It is nonsplit, with actual ample L=O_X(1) of raw degree 2.

Over E=K(i), [s:r] maps to [s^2-r^2:i(s^2+r^2):2sr], an actual isomorphism; its two inverse charts are [X0-iX1:X2] and [X2:-X0-iX1]. Thus L_E=O(2). Galois conjugation in this coordinate is coefficient conjugation followed by z->-1/z. It fixes Gauss. Since |2|=|i|=1, the embedding FS norm equals twice the standard line norm, using max(|s^2-r^2|,|s^2+r^2|,|2sr|)=max(|s|,|r|)^2. Hence its reference measure is 2 delta_xi and the norming identity holds.

Let y_-=zeta(0,|t|) and y_+=zeta(0,|t|^-1) on the actual split upstairs line. Their G orbit is this pair; Gal(bar K/E) fixes each disk and conjugation exchanges them. Their image eta differs from xi, since D fibers are orbits and Gauss has its singleton orbit. The invariant measure delta_y-+delta_y+ pushes to mu=2 delta_eta. Degree-two scaled actual atom metrics give outputs 2 delta_y- and 2 delta_y+ on actual O(2); O and Q imply finite intrinsic dual of their half-sum. D preserves that dual downstairs. The actual tensor sum of the two degree-one atom metrics has scalar u=-g(.,y_-)-g(.,y_+) relative to twice the standard reference. Its genuine measure is that invariant sum, and Q uniqueness plus normalization makes the metric invariant, so it descends. Each self-kernel has length 1, the cross-kernel is zero, and u(Gauss)=0. Thus int u dmu=-2, E(u)=-1, and n2 gives J(mu)=1. Theorem n2 allows arbitrary finite-energy target support, not only these atoms.

Finite computational observations are separately limited. python3 finite_checks.py returned exit 0 and status PASS. On the six vertices a,l,o,r,b,c with edges a-l length1, l-o length2, o-r length2, r-b length1, o-c length2, the involution exchanges a/b and l/r and fixes o,c. It checks its distance preservation and all 21 half-unit edge-grid positions: diameter is 6 and the unique grid circumcenter is o, fixed by the involution. For all 15 probability vectors of denominator 4 on leaves a,b,c, with diagonal root kernel (3,3,2), it checks target mass 2 and E=-mu^T G mu/2, objective=mu^T G mu/2. It checks the conic polynomial identity in rational arithmetic, the explicit two-atom mass2/E=-1/integral=-2/objective1, and an edge of length sqrt2 with endpoint difference1, slopes0 and1 and split sqrt2-1, whose endpoint and nonnegative bend are exact in Q(sqrt2). These are exhaustive only for the specified finite grids, not for analytic potentials or fields.

notes.summary: Original P16.4 is not closed: the new complete theorem is genus-zero only. Fresh whole-unit source checks preserve the general-curve model-realization gap; an exact irrational-cycle slope obstruction is diagnostic, not an all-genus equation.
notes.detailedSummary: n2 gives a complete nonsplit genus-zero extension but leaves positive-genus curves and dimensions at least two unresolved. GJKM literal v3 entire Section3 and BE literal v3 complete Th7.8/Cor7.9 proof were read as diagnostics, not applied to unconstructed graph metrics; semistable/algebraization/model/slope dependencies have not been reconstructed. notes.text:
This is a diagnostic scope/provenance note, not a theorem of impossibility. The whole original P16.4 asks for every smooth geometrically integral projective X of arbitrary dimension, actual ample rational L, every retained complete characteristic-zero real-valued field with residue characteristic zero, and arbitrary positive Radon mass-(L^n) finite-energy targets. The new theorem n2 closes only all genus-zero curves, including nonsplit nontrivially valued cases; it does not close general curves or higher dimensions. Operator and locality/comparison in the full retained domain are supplied mathematical grants O and C, not new proofs replacing all six caller bodies.

Still unproved here for general X are normalized actual-potential compactness with a usable convergence topology, general envelope/orthogonality and both-sign outer continuous-direction differentiation where a variational proof needs them, a general intrinsic all-E1 target converse or another adequate target estimate, actual attainment for each target, and every-solution allpoint uniqueness. D supplies conditional equation transfer only after actual upstairs existence/uniqueness. Completing an algebraic closure does not make a nondiscrete valuation discrete. Positive-residue-characteristic P16.3, nonample P16.5 and nonalgebraizable P16.7 remain separate originals.

Fresh primary inspection used literal https://arxiv.org/pdf/1712.00980v3, Gubler--Jell--Kunnemann--Martin, submitted2018-11-22, with manuscript date2018-11-26. The entire Section3, browser lines462-743 including complete propositions3.5,3.7,3.8,3.10 and theorem3.1 proofs and the final discrete-only rationality subsection, was read. Its arbitrary nontrivial complete-field curve model and continuous-envelope statements do not automatically realize arbitrary graph distributions as actual metrics. Their semistable refinements, formal algebraization, model recognition and slope formula dependencies were identified but not independently reconstructed here, so these specialized results are not applied in the positive proof. Literal https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.01016v3, Boucksom--Eriksson v3 dated2021-01-08, complete Th7.8/Cor7.9 proof (browser lines3853-3884), was read. It recognizes actual nef model metrics on actual ample bundles, using actual ample-model domination and perturbation. It cannot provide the missing model by naming a graph function. That check is diagnostic only.

The arithmetic obstruction is proved independently: on two parallel fixed edges of lengths1 andsqrt2, rational slopes for a common endpoint difference d require both d and d/sqrt2 rational. If d is nonzero this would make sqrt2 rational; hence d=0. Thus density of rational slopes cannot simply be assumed on a fixed irrational cycle. For one edge of length ell and difference d with rational s1<d/ell<s2, splitting at t=(d-s2 ell)/(s1-s2) in (0,ell) gives s1 t+s2(ell-t)=d and a nonnegative slope bend. If ell,d lie in a divisible value group, so does t. This endpoint calculation, also checked at ell=sqrt2,d=1,s1=0,s2=1, is not positivity at all vertices, analytic formal frames, actual model recognition or a fixed-bundle FS realization proof. No conditional graph equation is presented as a solution.

Stacks primary live pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0C6L and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0C6U were retrieved on2026-10-07; complete pertinent genus-zero statements and proofs were inspected, and the needed splitting implication is independently reconstructed in n1/paper Section2. Further ordinary algebraic foundation pages02LS,0AB1 and degree/base-change portion0AYQ were inspected; the final splitting proof avoids importing proper-quasi-finite finiteness and finite-map degree machinery.
